slice: Bind repertory production acceptance to exact-commit immutable deployment evidence and physical iPhone Safari audibility evidence.
finding: Activation preconditions and a running audio route are insufficient for production acceptance. Acceptance must fail closed unless the activation assessment, immutable deployment identity, and human-observed physical iPhone Safari audibility evidence agree on the same tested commit and deployment id.

verification.environment: isolated Node-compatible local execution using the committed source text
claims_not_made: No Vercel deployment was created or verified.
No browser audio route was observed.
No physical iPhone audibility was observed.

privacy_boundary: No private source text, credentials, personal records, analytics, payments, or conversion logic were introduced.

reversibility.rollback: Revert the additive evidence, test, and module commits in reverse order.

reason_no_registry_change: The existing Vercel Studio reliability, audio, mobile Safari, test, deployment verification, and rollback roles cover this capability.
